expectedEffect: Reduce the 5.7 s transport-in-flight portion of etch-l2's current shortage and reduce inspection-1's 58.584 s attributed shortage; change the lane latency from 1.2 s to 0.6 s and build cost from 229,790 to 229,940 while remaining below the 230,000 cap; keep capacity READY, all five current-factory case scores non-regressing, 12/12 lots on time, delivery, quality prevention, Q-time, yield, scrap, escapes, and all hard outcomes unchanged or improved.
statement: Upgrade only lithography-to-etch-lithography-l2 from the ordinary conveyor and two sorter endpoints to the already qualified vacuum wafer conveyor and vacuum sorters, preserving the seven-cell raised route, every Device position, every process mode, and the downstream inspection and rework lanes. Halving this upstream physical handoff should reduce etch-l2 transport starvation and the subsequent inspection source-waiting interval without globally accelerating lithography or etch.
